subject: Request: expedited redline and SOW patch for Phase Gamma rollout
messages:
From: Sasha Petrov <sasha@koretech.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Morales <anna@koretech.ai>, Legal (KoreTech) <legal@koretech.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: expedited redline for MSA + order form (Phase Gamma)

Hi Vivek —

We're preparing to move Phase Gamma into production (targeting May 10) and need an expedited redline on the MSA and order form. Key asks from procurement/engineering: 
- Add 200 reserved GPU hours per month (pilot->production) as an exhibit to the order form.
- Amend SOW to add an implementation milestone (integration window + acceptance tests).
- Supplier-proposed burst pricing in section 3 needs clarification; customer expects cap on per-token surcharges.
- KoreTech legal flagged a carve-out to the liability section and a longer data retention period request.

I've attached our initial redlines (KoreTech_Redlines_v1.pdf). Can Redwood review and send back an internal assessment by EOD Monday 4/20? Procurement is on a compressed sign schedule and would like to avoid a full MSA renegotiation.

Thanks —
Sasha Petrov
Head of Procurement, KoreTech
[Attachment: KoreTech_Redlines_v1.pdf (pdf)]
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Morales <anna@koretech.ai>, Sasha Petrov <sasha@koretech.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: expedited redline for MSA + order form (Phase Gamma)

Team — forwarding KoreTech's redlines. Highlights they want:
- +200 reserved GPU hours / month (exhibit)
- explicit implementation/acceptance milestone in SOW
- cap on burst pricing / per-token surcharge language softened
- data retention window increase + liability carve-out request

Quick thoughts: capacity add is straightforward operationally but we should insist on phased acceptance and an implementation acceptance gate to limit exposure. The liability carve-out could be material — Laura, can you confirm whether the requested language (see attached) creates a disqualifying risk?

Karthik, please evaluate ops/runbook implications for the extra reserved pool and whether autoscale rules need to change. Connor — can you prepare a short commercial counterproposal with a non-negotiable fallback (e.g., 4% surcharge cap; 30-day acceptance test) and a change-order template we can share?

I aim to have an internal position by EOD Monday (4/20) so we can respond before their sign date next week.

Thanks,
Vivek
VP, Commercial 
Redwood Inference
[Forwarded attachment: KoreTech_Redlines_v1.pdf (pdf)]
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: expedited redline for MSA + order form (Phase Gamma)

Vivek / team —

Thanks for the ping. I pulled Product and Finance into my headspace and sketched a commercial counter that should be acceptable without changing our core MSA posture: 
- Capacity: Accept add of 200 reserved GPU hours, with phased ramp: 50% reserved for first 30 days, full provisioning after acceptance testing.
- Pricing: Counter 4% surcharge on burst usage (not 8% as they implied). Cap absolute surcharge per month (e.g., $12k).
- SOW: Add milestone-based acceptance (integration test window 14 days; formal sign-off by engineering).
- Liability/data: Push back on any carve-outs that waive core indemnities. Offer 90-day retention as a compromise (their ask was 180).

Attached a draft change order template and a short commercial summary you can use with Legal. If Laura signs off on the legal language, we can send a tracked-change counter by EOD Monday.

Attached: change_order_template_v2.docx

Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Morales <anna@koretech.ai>, Legal (KoreTech) <legal@koretech.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: expedited redline for MSA + order form (Phase Gamma)

Team / KoreTech —

Appreciate the clarity in Connor's proposal. High-level legal positions below and inline suggested language for their redlines (see attached redline_response_koretech_v1.pdf):

1) Liability carve-out (Section 10): Unacceptable as written. We can offer narrower customer-favorable language that preserves vendor indemnities. Suggested replacement: "Notwithstanding any other provision, neither party's aggregate liability for direct damages arising from the Agreement shall exceed the fees paid in the prior twelve (12) months, except for liabilities arising from willful misconduct or gross negligence."

2) Data retention: Offer 90-day default retention for logs and 180 days for aggregated telemetry. If KoreTech requires 180-day raw data retention, we need a commercial uplift.

3) SOW acceptance: Insert the following acceptance gate: "Customer shall perform integration tests within 14 calendar days from deployment; absent written rejection with test failure evidence, acceptance will be deemed effective on day 15."

4) Change order mechanics: Use our change_order_template_v2; require a single signed change order to amend quantity/price. No unilateral modifications permitted.

If KoreTech accepts the above, this is contractually tidy and operationally feasible. If they insist on the full liability carve-out or 180-day raw-data retention without uplift, route this to Legal leadership for escalation.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts 
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redline_response_koretech_v1.pdf (pdf)]
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Petrov <sasha@koretech.ai>, Anna Morales <anna@koretech.ai>, procurement@koretech.ai
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: expedited redline for MSA + order form (Phase Gamma)

Sasha / Anna —

Thanks for the redlines and for being flexible on timing. After internal review we can move quickly if KoreTech is comfortable with the following counterproposal: 

1) Capacity: Redwood will add the 200 reserved GPU hours as Exhibit A to the Order Form with a phased ramp (50% provisioned immediately; remainder after successful acceptance testing as defined in the SOW).

2) Pricing: We propose a 4% surcharge on burst usage rather than the 8% suggested in your redlines. Additionally we will hard-cap total monthly surcharge at $12,000 to provide spend predictability.

3) SOW / acceptance: We will add an acceptance gate: 14-day integration test window followed by deemed acceptance on day 15 unless material test failures are documented.

4) Data retention & liability: Redwood cannot accept broad liability carve-outs. We will offer 90-day raw-data retention as our standard for logs and 180 days for aggregated telemetry. For 180-day raw-data retention we can provide a commercial uplift; let us know if you'd like pricing for that option.

Attached is a short counterproposal (Redwood_Counterproposal_20260420.pdf) with tracked changes for the order form and SOW. If this looks acceptable, we can prepare a signed change order and route it through DocuSign. Please confirm by EOD Tuesday 4/27 so we can meet KoreTech's Go-Live target.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcd-1234-PhaseGamma

Looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Vivek
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Counterproposal_20260420.pdf (pdf)]
